people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
translations.bsb: And the king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
translations.kjv: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
translations.asv: And the king of Egypt deposed him at Jerusalem, and fined the land a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
